headline: Financial market 24h: gold prices plunge at end of day
summary: The VN-Index continued to fall in the past 24 hours, and long-term savings interest rates hit a new peak. Gold prices also fell at the end of the day, according to the report.
why: The VN-Index is the benchmark for Vietnam's main equity exchange in Ho Chi Minh City. Deposit rates influence the flow of household savings between banks and stocks.
why_moved: The VN-Index kept falling while long-term savings interest rates reached a new peak. Higher deposit rates can draw cash away from equities.
